chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Sa'dan ibn Muslim, from Muawiya ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

My father, when he sought a need, sought it at the decline of the sun (midday). So whenever he intended that, he would give something in charity, smell some perfume, go to the Masjid, and supplicate regarding his need with whatever he desired.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended etiquette and timing for making dua to have one's needs fulfilled according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) prescribed seeking needs at the time of *zawal* (midday), a period traditionally associated with the transition from the Dhuhr to Asr prayers, emphasizing spiritual preparation through charity (*sadaqah*) and fragrance (*attar*) to purify the self before entering the mosque. This practice reflects the Shia emphasis on combining physical cleanliness with material generosity to enhance the receptivity of supplication, aligning with the Prophetic tradition that charity extinguishes divine wrath.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Sa’dan Bin Muslim, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘It was so that whenever my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> sought the need, sought it during the decline of the sun (at midday). So whenever he<sup>asws</sup> intended that, he<sup>asws</sup> preceded it with something and gave it in charity with it, and smelt something from the perfume, and went to the Masjid and supplicated regarding his<sup>asws</sup> need with whatever he<sup>asws</sup> so desired to’.
en.sarwar: 7. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Su’Dan ibn Muslim from Mu’awiyah ibn ‘Ammar from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Whenever my father prayed to Allah for help he would do so at noontime when the sun began to descend to the western horizon. When he intended it, first he would give something in charity, use perfume, go to the Mosque and pray to Allah for whatever he wanted.”
